ready1_open_rewrite.raw_question_text: As shown in the figure, place $ \angle BAC$ on a $5\times 5$ square grid. If the vertices A, B, and C are all on the grid points, then what is the value of the tangent of $ \angle BAC$?
ready1_open_rewrite.raw_answer_text:
\textbf{Solution:} As shown in the figure, connect BC,\\
then $AB=BC=\sqrt{1^2+3^2}=\sqrt{10}$, $AC=\sqrt{2^2+4^2}=2\sqrt{5}$,\\
$\therefore AB^2+BC^2=10+10=20=AC^2$,\\
$\therefore \triangle ABC$ is an isosceles right triangle, and $\angle ABC=90^\circ$,\\
$\therefore \angle BAC=45^\circ$,\\
then $\tan\angle BAC=\boxed{1}$.

claims.source: Because AB^2+BC^2=10+10=20=AC^2, triangle ABC is right-angled at B

claims.claim: Triangle ABC is right-angled at B.
claims.label: reasoning
claims.source: So triangle ABC is right-angled at B

claims.claim: AB=BC。
claims.label: reasoning
claims.source: Also because AB=BC

claims.claim: Triangle ABC is an isosceles right triangle.
claims.label: reasoning
claims.source: So triangle ABC is an isosceles right triangle

claims.claim: The two acute angles of an isosceles right triangle are both 45°.
claims.label: knowledge
claims.source: Triangle ABC is an isosceles right triangle, therefore ∠BAC=45°

claims.label: reasoning
claims.source: Therefore ∠BAC=45°

claims.label: knowledge
claims.source: tan∠BAC=tan45°=1

claims.claim: tan∠BAC=1。
claims.label: reasoning
claims.source: So tan∠BAC=tan45°=1
